newsitem.title: UK: Royal & Sun to gain full control of Taikoo.
newsitem.headline: Royal & Sun to gain full control of Taikoo.

text.p: British insurance group Royal & Sun Alliance said on Friday that it had reached an agreement to buy Swire Pacific Ltd's 49 percent stake in Taikoo Royal Insurance, a major Hong Kong insurance firm.
The sale will give the UK group 100 percent ownership of Taikoo Royal, which would be merged with Sun Alliance' Hong Kong branch.
Robin Rowland, group director of Royal & Sun Alliance's international operations, said post-merger it would be one of the biggest non-life insurance operations in Hong Kong.
The 1995 proforma combined premium income of Taikoo Royal and Sun Alliance Hongkong was 27 million stg.
"The consideration paid is less than 0.5 percent of the proforma net aset value of Royal & Sun Alliance.
